name: Niedax Group (Niedax GmbH & Co. KG)
note: Niedax Group is a family-owned German cable-management manufacturer based in Linz am Rhein (founded 1920 in Berlin as Niedergesäß & Co); its personally liable partner is Niedax Beteiligungs GmbH & Co. KG, held via Niedax Verwaltungs GmbH. niedax-group.com history: 'still 100% family-owned to this day'.
